quote: They're loud, but I think we need to be louder. It can't be my voice, because I'm the baby killer, the cheater. It needs to be your voice—a clear voice. I'm already testifying at the court martial. But that's closed to the media. It's not enough.
chinese: 他们声音很大 但我觉得我们得更响 不能由我发声 因为我已被称为杀婴者和出轨者 必须是你的声音 一个清白的声音 我已经在军事法庭作证 但那里不对媒体开放 还不够
reason: 以声量隐喻说明发言人选择，并回应已有行动不足。

quote: There are so many people this has happened to. Why does it have to be me? Because you're the one who called.
chinese: 这种事发生在很多人身上 为什么一定是我 因为是你主动打来的电话
reason: 简短回应“为什么是我”，以主动求助作为理由。

quote: When the Vice President brought you on board, I advised against it. But I can't deny you've done a good job. I'm very protective of the Vice President. I find it hard to share that duty, which leaves me open to error. It's one of my faults. I understand trust is something I need to earn. If the Vice President trusts you, then I trust you. We're a team now. I can't do this alone.
chinese: 副总统录用你时 我曾反对 但我不能否认你做得很好 我非常保护副总统 很难与别人分担这份职责 这让我容易犯错 是我的缺点之一 我明白信任需要自己争取 如果副总统信任你 我就信任你 我们现在是一个团队 我无法独自完成
reason: 从承认偏见与缺点到明确建立团队，工作沟通价值高。

quote: We have two tasks. First, find me Remy Danton, but be discreet. Second, go through the Vice President's travel logs—everything in the past 10 years. What are we looking for? Anything that could hurt us. I'll work forward. You work backward.
chinese: 我们有两项任务 第一 找到雷米·丹顿 但要谨慎 第二 翻查副总统过去十年的全部行程记录 我们要找什么 任何可能伤害我们的东西 我从前往后查 你从后往前查
reason: 清楚列任务、范围、目标与分工，可直接迁移。

quote: We're talking about impeachable offenses, Frank. I had a gut feeling the casino was involved. I sent Doug down there to get to the bottom of it. You should have taken this to the DOJ at the first inkling. That's exactly what I didn't want—to create a ruckus if nothing was going on. You can't go on conducting your own investigations. chinese: 我们谈的是足以弹劾的罪行 弗兰克 我直觉赌场牵涉其中 所以派道格去查清 你一有怀疑就该去司法部 我正是不想在毫无其事时制造风波 你不能继续私自调查 不管叫查明事实还是尽职调查 如果有人违法 我必须知道
reason: 必要 Context：从严重性、调查动机到程序争议，完整呈现双方立场。

quote: Maybe what I did was wrong, but I didn't do anything illegal. You certain of that? I've discussed this at length with my lawyers. Dunbar doesn't strike me as the sort who will put on the brakes even if we admit all of this. In fact, it might encourage her to dig deeper.
chinese: 也许我做错了 但没有违法 你确定吗 我已与律师详细讨论过 邓巴不像会因我们承认这些就收手的人 事实上这可能促使她深挖
reason: 区分错误与违法，并评估披露后的调查反应。

quote: Which is why I want to hand over all of my travel logs. I think you should, too. Volunteer them? As a gesture of cooperation. Haven't we made enough gestures? That'll take the wind out of her sails.
chinese: 所以我想交出全部行程记录 我认为您也该交 自愿交吗 作为合作姿态 我们做的姿态还不够多吗 这会削弱她的势头
reason: 用主动披露换取调查降温，方案与质疑都完整。

quote: Imagine the fallout if the public found out. A needle in a haystack, and not a needle Dunbar is looking for. She's interviewed half of Congress. That woman's after blood, but not for gossip. Even if she raises an eyebrow, you were visiting a sick friend, weren't you?
chinese: 想象公众知道后的后果 那是草堆里的一根针 而且不是邓巴在找的那根 她已会见半个国会 那女人要的是血 不是八卦 即使她起疑 你只是去探望生病的朋友 对吧
reason: 把暴露风险压缩为可解释事件，保留政治话术识别。

quote: He'll advise you against it, which is his job. But I would encourage you to think politics, not legalese.
chinese: 他会建议你别这么做 那是他的职责 但我建议你考虑政治 而不是法律术语
reason: 区分法律顾问职责与政治判断，简短可迁移。

quote: Are you honestly threatening me? Set up a meeting with Frank. I don't care what you talk about, as long as you're alone and the meeting is on the books. Then sit down with Dunbar. Tell her Frank grilled you on your testimony. Perjure myself? Save your seat.
chinese: 你真在威胁我吗 安排与弗兰克见面 我不在乎谈什么 只要你单独赴会且有正式记录 然后去找邓巴 告诉她弗兰克逼问过你的证词 让我作伪证吗 保住你的席位
reason: 涉及以伪证换政治利益的胁迫，仅作剧情识别。

quote: Tell everyone. Think how that would play out. I don't care. You'd really toss yourself off a cliff for Frank? I have zero allegiance to Frank Underwood. I won't be manipulated by him, and I sure won't be manipulated by you. I'm not bluffing.
chinese: 告诉所有人吧 想想后果 我不在乎 你真要为弗兰克毁掉自己吗 我不效忠弗兰克·安德伍德 我不会被他操纵 更不会被你操纵 我不是虚张声势
reason: 用明确边界拒绝两方操纵，角色力量鲜明。

quote: Then I was right. About what? How little I meant. That has nothing to do with this. It has everything to do with this. I should feel disgusted, but I don't. Just supremely disappointed.
chinese: 那我就判断对了 关于什么 我对你有多不重要 这与此无关 这与此完全有关 我应该感到厌恶 但没有 只是极度失望
reason: 从政治冲突转入私人失望，语气连续完整。

quote: The President is turning over everything? From the day he took office. We're sure this includes the visits to his friend? It has to. Full security detail. We have something we can work with. As for my logs—they're clean. You'd bet your life on that? I would. We've been through them twice, backward and forward.
chinese: 总统要交出一切吗 从就职那天起 我们确定包括探望那位朋友吗 必须包括 当时全套安保 我们有可利用的地方了 至于我的记录 很干净 你敢拿命保证吗 敢 我们已经正反检查了两遍
reason: 从对手漏洞到自身复核，风险核验链条清晰。

quote: We need to go wide with this the moment the interview is over, so we beat Dunbar to the punch in case she releases something. I'll be at my computer, ready to press Send the moment I hear from Doug. Have either of you slept? We're awake. Fully operational.
chinese: 会面一结束就要广泛发布 这样若邓巴也准备公布什么 我们可以先发制人 我会守在电脑前 一收到道格消息就按发送 你们睡过吗 我们醒着 全速运转
reason: 把触发条件、负责人和发布时间说清，适合计划表达。

quote: The person who was attacked gets attacked all over again. How did that make you feel? It made me angry. The lawyer kept coming after me about my panic attacks, my antidepressants. chinese: 遭到伤害的人会再次受到攻击 那让你有什么感受 我很愤怒 律师不断追问我的恐慌发作和抗抑郁药 但我一直盯着麦金尼斯 我要让他看见我承受得住 我很坚强 我要让他先移开目光 他移开了吗 是的 他背叛了国家 夺走了一名优秀的海军陆战队员
reason: 涉及性侵后创伤与公开作证，仅作为敏感主题识别。

quote: I have no problem being patient, as long as it leads to forthright answers. I won't make you wait a moment longer.
chinese: 我不介意耐心等待 只要最终能得到坦率回答 我不会再让你多等一刻
reason: 把耐心与坦率作为交换条件，简洁可迁移。

quote: They're worried about Lanagin. He's a little shaky, but he'll hold up. Underwood? Birch delivered. Did Dunbar bring up Stamper? The sessions are closed-door, but I can't imagine she didn't.
chinese: 他们担心拉尼根 他有些动摇 但能撑住 安德伍德呢 博奇完成了 邓巴提斯坦普了吗 会面闭门进行 但我想她不可能不提

quote: Do you think that's because there's nothing there, or because he's protecting her? There's nothing there. It has to be somebody high-profile, someone in the leadership who will make waves. This can't look orchestrated. Multiple fronts, Remy. It has to be Jackie Sharp.

quote: You denied being a back channel. I did not deny it. I chose not to confirm because it was classified. When a back channel becomes public, it defeats its purpose. chinese: 你否认自己是秘密沟通渠道 我没有否认 我选择不确认 因为那是机密 秘密渠道一旦公开就失去作用 如果拒绝评论 人们会认为确有其事 这会危及进程 我实在没有选择
reason: 必要 Context：解释未确认与否认的区别，以及公开渠道的风险。

quote: I know he laundered the money. It's just a matter of time before I have proof. My question, which I am asking again, is whether you knew. And I will repeat my answer: I did not.
chinese: 我知道是他洗的钱 找到证据只是时间问题 我再次问 你当时是否知情 我也重复回答 我不知情
reason: 以重复提问对重复否认，审问节奏清晰。

chinese: 我确实感觉有些不对 道格也知道我的担忧 我决定亲自查清 副总统不知情 但这不代表我不为手下的行为负全责 责任止于我

quote: That may have been misguided logic, but that's how I chose to act. The mistake is mine and mine alone—not Doug's, and certainly not the President's.
chinese: 也许这个逻辑有误 但那是我当时选择的行动方式 错误属于我一个人 不属于道格 当然更不属于总统
reason: 承认判断可能有误，同时清晰界定责任边界。

quote: It feels like I am not getting the full picture. Which is why I'm prepared to give you the full picture. The White House believes in transparency. All of the Vice President's personal travel logs, the last 10 years since I became whip, as well as the President's since inauguration.
chinese: 我觉得自己没有看到全貌 所以我准备把全貌交给你 白宫相信透明度 这里有副总统全部私人出行记录 我担任党鞭以来十年的记录 以及总统就职以来的记录
reason: 借对方措辞转入主动披露，信息范围明确。

quote: There should be no doubt as to whom we met with and when. If you have questions or requests, we'll be happy to facilitate.
chinese: 我们何时与谁见面都不应再有疑问 如果你有任何问题或要求 我们很乐意协助

quote: At first I was really nervous. But as soon as I started speaking from my heart, all these things poured out—everything I'd been wanting to say. I want to do more: interviews, articles, TV, whatever it takes. I want to help. Thank you for making me do this. It was a big step for me.
chinese: 起初我真的很紧张 但一开始真心表达 一切都自然涌出 那些一直想说的话 我还想做更多 采访 报刊 电视 不论需要什么 我都想帮忙 谢谢你让我做这件事 这对我是很大一步
reason: 从紧张到行动意愿，完整表达一次突破后的反馈。

chinese: 你先回芝加哥吧 等我们制定好计划就联系你 她情绪起伏很大 容易受惊又亢奋 她确实显得紧张 我们没怎么交谈
reason: 从礼貌送行转入心理状态观察，保留为识别性场景。

quote: The coverage has been mostly positive so far. Dunbar's office says they look forward to reviewing the logs. Any heat on Doug? Some. I'm getting requests for comment. chinese: 目前报道大多正面 邓巴办公室说期待审查记录 有人盯上道格吗 有一些 很多人要求评论 那是我个人行动 我会全力配合司法部 可以对外这样说吗 可能引来更多关注 关注我 而不是副总统 无论发生什么我都能应付
reason: 必要 Context：从舆情更新到由 Doug 主动吸引关注，风险承担完整。

quote: Should I find a way to tip off Dunbar? Let nature take its course. We got hold of Remy. He just got back to town. Where is he? I've arranged everything with your detail. You've done good work, Doug.
chinese: 要设法给邓巴透风吗 让事情自然发展吧 我们联系上雷米了 他刚回城 他在哪 我已经和你的安保安排妥当 你做得很好 道格
reason: 先拒绝额外操控，再确认会面安排并给予反馈。

quote: “To improve is to change. To perfect is to change often.” What sort of change are you looking for? Whichever leaves me options. Trouble at Glendon Hill? Paid leave until the investigation is over. First step in terminating my partnership. No matter what happens, there's a stain I can't wash out.
chinese: “变则善 常变则至善” 你想要什么样的改变 能让我保有选择的改变 格兰顿-希尔有麻烦吗 调查结束前带薪休假 是终止我合伙人身份的第一步 无论发生什么 都会留下洗不掉的污点
reason: 以手表引语切入职业危机和选项需求，场景连贯。

quote: I'm not offering myself to you wholesale. I keep fighting you, but I can fight you less. And by “less” you mean? Enough to hurt, but not finish you. reason: 必要 Context：完整呈现有限对抗、交换条件与中立报价。

quote: Where is this coming from? Insurance, that's all. Does it have anything to do with Jackie? That's over. This is about my future, pure and simple. She's not a part of it. Keep the watch as a token of good faith.
chinese: 这想法从哪来 只是保险而已 与杰姬有关吗 已经结束了 这纯粹关乎我的未来 她不在其中 留着手表 当作诚意的象征
reason: 追问动机、排除私人关系，并用物件确认诚意。

quote: He might deny it, but he's protecting her. What he doesn't realize is I have even less regard for Jackie than Raymond does. Poor Remy. The heart can choke the mind when all its blood flows back unto itself.
chinese: 他也许会否认 但他在保护她 他没意识到 我比雷蒙德更不在乎杰姬 可怜的雷米 当全部血液都倒流回心脏 感情便会扼住理智
reason: 完整 Frank 镜头独白，以心脏与血流隐喻情感遮蔽判断。

quote: Looks like I almost missed the party. I'm off the clock, sir. Relax. I broke a glass, and Edward cut his hand. I hope you don't mind, sir. I was off-duty. Is she drunk? A little. How many have you had? A few. More than a few.
chinese: 看来我差点错过派对 我下班了 先生 放松 我打破了杯子 艾德华割伤了手 希望您别介意 先生 我当时已下班 她喝醉了吗 有一点 你喝了多少 几杯 不止几杯吧
reason: 涉及醉酒、受伤与越界亲密的剧情铺垫，仅作识别。

quote: How's your head? Fine. Took a few aspirin before I went to sleep. You? I slept like a baby. Good. You needed that.
chinese: 头怎么样 没事 睡前吃了几片阿司匹林 你呢 我睡得像婴儿一样香 很好 你需要好好睡一觉
reason: 片尾简短关心与回应，保留关系语气。
